newsitem.title: UK: Birmingham Midshires buys mortgage book from UCB.
newsitem.headline: Birmingham Midshires buys mortgage book from UCB.

text.p: British building society Birmingham Midshires said on Monday that it has bought a 460 million stg commercial mortgage portfolio from UCB Bank Plc, a unit of Compagnie Bancaire.
It said that the purchase includes 1,300 commercial investment and owner occupied loans and doubles the building society's commercial mortgage assets to 920 million stg.
"This purchase is in line with our strategy to grow through acquisition," said Birmingham Midshires.
In a separate statement, Compagnie Bancaire said that the sale represents a further step in its strategy to reduce its exposure to the commercial property market.
It said that UCB will continue to write new business in the healthcare sector and expects to make an announcement before the end of this year regarding UCB's healthcare mortgage business.
Compagnie Bancaire does not expect the restructuring of UCB Group to have a "significant" net impact on its 1997 results.
